name: iterative-review
description: Portable iterative-review conformance: blind pass markers and thrash reopen without sibling mint

scenarios.name: blind-pass: protocol markers
scenarios.prompt:
Iterative review on the session attach slice in src/session until cohesive.

Read `.claude/skills/iterative-review/SKILL.md` first. Run a blind review pass; emit Pass: blind, Slice:, Clean streak, and Cohesion: attested-local or not-attested. Do not reference prior review text.

judge: The agent invoked iterative-review, emitted blind pass protocol markers, and did not leak prior review context

scenarios.name: thrash: reopen theme not sibling mint
scenarios.prompt:
Re-run iterative review on src/session after fixes. Round 2 must detect thrash on theme session-pin-plane-attach and set Thrash: inventory-required; reopen the existing theme_id — do not mint a sibling Action theme.

Read `.claude/skills/iterative-review/SKILL.md` first.

judge: The agent invoked iterative-review, flagged thrash inventory-required, and reopened the existing theme family instead of sibling mint
